title: Part Twenty-Five: The Nag Hammadi Library, Text by Text

sections.brief: The December 1945 find at Jabal al-Tarif: 13 codices (XIII = leaves in VI's cover), 52 tractates / 46 distinct, Coptic from Greek, cartonnage to 348, made c.350; Robinson's discovery story (mother's oven, blood feud) vs Goodacre 2013 and Doresse; Tanos, Coptic Museum, Jung Codex (returned 1975), facsimile 1970s, English 1977; burial hypotheses: Robinson/Lundhaug-Jenott monastic vs Lewis-Blount grave goods; Athanasius 367 warns, no burn order; a mixed library (Plato, Hermetica, Sextus, Silvanus). Figures: time (348-1988); compare (burial hypotheses)

Gospel of Thomas (114 sayings, Oxyrhynchus fragments, sayings 3, 14, 70, 108, 113, 114; Hippolytus, Cyril c.350, Decretum; Patterson/Cameron early vs Goodacre/Gathercole dependence), Gospel of Truth (Irenaeus AH III.11.9), Gospel of Philip (five mysteries, resurrection before death, koinonos and the lacuna), Apocryphon of James, Thomas the Contender, Dialogue of the Saviour, Treatise on the Resurrection. Figures: compare (Thomas/Truth/Philip)

Apocryphon of John outlined (Monad to return) with Irenaeus AH I.29 parallel and antisemitism caution; Hypostasis of the Archons, Origin of the World, Trimorphic Protennoia, Thunder; Holy Book, Apocalypse of Adam; ascent texts (Zostrianos, Allogenes, Marsanes, Three Steles) with Plotinus/Porphyry and Epiphanius; Tripartite Tractate; anti-episcopal texts (Apocalypse of Peter 'dry canals', Second Treatise of Seth, Testimony of Truth); labelled interpretation of Sophia's fall as ascent map. Figures: flow (Apocryphon of John)

Complete catalogue of all 13 codices and 52 tractates with one-line teaching, conflict with institutional teaching (creed of 325, four-gospel rule, water baptism, bodily resurrection, church offices) and named condemnation (Irenaeus, Hippolytus, Cyril, Athanasius 367, Epiphanius, Decretum Gelasianum, Plotinus/Porphyry as pagan critics); what the count shows and where it complicates the 'kingdom within' reading. Figures: compare (full catalogue)
